detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

We're still looking for a European Cloudflare replacement and haven't settled on one.

What we've found so far: no single EU provider covers DNS + CDN + DDoS + WAF at Cloudflare's price. 

Bunny.net comes closest to doing it all. 

Eight of them compared, with prices:
https://euronomy.eu/e/it-services/european-cloudflare-alternatives/

If you've made the switch, what are you running, and what went wrong? 

#CDN #SelfHosted #DigitalSovereignty #buyFromEU
